title: Japanese-Style Silky Labneh Parfait
description: A light and refreshing dessert inspired by Japanese cuisine, featuring silky labneh and a delicate sauce.
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together the saudi honey and silk protein powder until well combined.
Add the water and whisk until the mixture forms a smooth sauce.
In a separate bowl, whisk the labneh until it's smooth and creamy.
Add the matcha powder to the labneh and whisk until well combined.
To assemble the parfait, place a layer of the labneh mixture at the bottom of the bowl.
Drizzle the honey-matcha sauce over the labneh layer.
Repeat the layers one more time, ending with a layer of the labneh mixture.
